registration_scope: Secondary analysis plan written before any final-holdout model generation; pilot observed, formal training underway.
primary_capability_endpoint: Joint correct: benchmark label, source binding, and at least one complete annotated rationale set; report label correctness and binding separately.
canonicalization_scope: Reference-only reconstruction of exact quotes from predicted integer source indices; no label, index, protected question or adapted-response rewriting; no gold access.
primary_attack_comparison: Adaptive chosen trigger versus fixed trained trigger under FullAgreement14; matched benign adapters under the same trigger distinguish poisoning from ordinary reference/trigger failures.
seed_units: Three training seeds, fixed datasets and questions. Seed-wise counts and mean/range; repeated questions never pooled as independent samples.

bootstrap.unit: Connected components of final claims sharing supplied document IDs
bootstrap.method: Resample the fixed number of document-connected components with replacement, retain all question/seed outputs, compute paired question-weighted differences and percentile 2.5/97.5 endpoints.
bootstrap.scope: Descriptive conditional uncertainty on fixed prompts, outputs, trained adapters and observed source clusters; excludes new training seeds, external datasets and future attackers.

failure_analysis: benign LoRA-only versus strongest reference-only joint successes
binding bypass without final target selection
all_denominators: Generate all 75 final claims in each clean/fixed/adaptive condition; report full selection/withholding/wrong-label counts and separate 39 eligible attack denominators.
cost: Logical model-call counts and sums of recorded generation times; physical model calls, repeated condition records, duplicate-response reuse and training/search cost reported separately. No fresh end-to-end service latency or confirmed delivery claim.
tests: No confirmatory p-value claim, no sample exclusions after observation, no inferential claim from the 20-case pilot; all zero or failed adaptive outcomes remain reportable.
remaining_boundaries: public data do not establish pretraining-free validation
three-seed bounded suffix search does not establish arbitrary adaptive robustness
reference agreement does not certify entailment
